g.title: MMD_QSP
g.text: Moyamoya Disease — Quantitative Systems Pharmacology Map
RNF213 → intimal hyperplasia → inlet conductance collapse → autoregulatory reserve exhaustion →
watershed failure, periventricular anastomotic haemorrhage, and the surgical restoration of a parallel conductance
Central identity: CBF = (MAP − ICP) / (1/g_S + R_art), g_S = g_ICA + g_moya + g_PVA + g_bypass, R_art ∈ [R_min, R_max]
Derived threshold: CBF_crit = CMRO₂ / (CaO₂ · OEF_max) — not a fitted parameter

g.title: cluster_sec
g.text: 2. Secondary drivers (quasi-moyamoya) — same lesion, no RNF213

g.title: cluster_inlet
g.text: 3. Four inlets in parallel — g_S = g_ICA + g_moya + g_PVA + g_bypass

g.title: cluster_hemo
g.text: 4. Haemodynamic network — the autoregulator has a FLOOR

g.title: cluster_ox
g.text: 5. Oxygen extraction ceiling — where the infarct threshold comes from

g.title: cluster_trig
g.text: 6. Precipitants — they act on the network, not on the lesion

g.title: cluster_surg
g.text: 8. Revascularisation — the only intervention that changes g_S

g.title: cluster_drug
g.text: 9. Pharmacology — every agent acts on a HAZARD, not on g_S

g.title: cluster_dx
g.text: 10. Diagnostics — what each modality can and cannot see
